gold: Type I cryoglobulinemia associated with multiple myeloma

selector.rationale: The presence of abnormal paraprotein band on serum and urine protein electrophoreses, monoclonal IgG-κ protein on immunofixation electrophoresis, and hypercellular marrow with 80% plasma cells supports Multiple Myeloma as the champion diagnosis.

rejected.label: Amyloidosis
rejected.why: Lack of direct evidence for amyloid deposits

rejected.label: Hypercalcemia of Malignancy
rejected.why: Hypercalcemia is better explained by Multiple Myeloma

rejected.label: Waldenström Macroglobulinemia
rejected.why: Less specific evidence and lower score compared to Multiple Myeloma
